messages.author: facf981883688355
messages.subject: exceedance probabilities
parts:
Good day all,
i want to   calculate the probabilities that stunting   prevalence exceeds 40%   by 2025 using 2008-2018 data for my analysis but the m1$marginals.fitted. values   gave me NULL.
m1 <- inla(formula,
            data = malnutrion,
            family = "binomial", Ntrials = 1,
            control.predictor = list(compute = TRUE),
            control.compute = list(dic = TRUE)
)
i need help.

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] exceedance probabilities
parts:
by default marginals.fitted.values are NULL as often the output is huge.

you can request it setting

control.compute=list(return.marginals.predictor=TRUE)
